learning_outcomes.text: Getting to know the methods of computer registration of measurements from various sensors
Mastering the ability to build simple systems of acquisition and signal generation
Has knowledge of the task and methods of condition diagnosis
knows and understands the methods of measurement, knows the calculation methods and computer tools necessary for the analysis of experimental results
is able to use computer methods in solving engineering tasks in the field of DAQ systems
Is able to use measurement apparatus and methods of estimating measurement errors
is ready to complete and critically

syllabus_topics: parameters of the DAQ system and characteristics
Measuring rotational speed with a tachometer
Degradation analysis of an example object using the time synchronous average method (TSA) in the run to failure test (RFT)
teaching_methods: feeding methods (informative lecture combined with a power-point presentation)
programmed methods (using a graphical programming environment such as MatLab)
practical methods (construction of measurement stations using: measurement cards, sensors)
assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all the required learning outcomes specified for the course.
